title: Consent-managed data sharing and open-banking permissions
workflow: Validate that data-sharing activity is legally and institutionally permitted
Authenticate customer and verify bank-account resource ownership
Display specific recipient, purpose, scope and expiry without dark patterns
Record versioned affirmative authorization with scoped token issuance
Enforce resource/action and consent validity on every data access
Revoke promptly and retain lawful evidence without allowing continued use
invariants: Possession of API client credentials is not customer authorization
Consent is optional where legally applicable and distinct from mandatory KYC processing
Partner access cannot exceed approved account and purpose scope
Revocation blocks future requests and downstream token usage
Data minimization and retention rules apply to recipients
Consent to view balances does not authorize initiating payment
Unconfirmed regulatory framework leaves production capability disabled
acceptance_tests: Revoked consent rejects next API call
Consent for one account cannot retrieve another
Partner receives no excess personal data
independent_gate: Verified current institution/jurisdiction data-sharing rules, partner agreements, privacy and security acceptance.
